mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COURSE_TARGET ( TARGET_ID, COURSE_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_VALUE ) VALUES ( 'T' || LPAD(NVL((SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TARGET_ID, 2))) + 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET), 1), 4, '0'), #{courseId}, #{targetType}, #{targetValue} )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO COURSE_TARGET CT USING (SELECT #{courseId} AS COURSE_ID FROM DUAL) SRC ON (CT.COURSE_ID = SRC.COURSE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CT.TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType}, CT.TARGET_VALUE = #{targetValue} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TARGET_ID, COURSE_ID, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_VALUE) VALUES ( 'T' || LPAD(NVL((SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TARGET_ID, 2))) + 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET), 1), 4, '0'), #{courseId}, #{targetType}, #{targetValue} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ENROLLMENT ( ENROLLMENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, COURSE_ID, STATUS, START_DATE, COMPLETED_DATE ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(ENROLLMENT_ID), 0) FROM ENROLLMENT) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY M.MEMBER_ID), M.MEMBER_ID, #{courseId}, 'Y', SYSDATE, NULL FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.STATUS = 'Y' AND M.ROLE = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT WHERE CT.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND ( CT.TARGET_TYPE = '전체' OR (CT.TARGET_TYPE = '부서' AND CT.TARGET_VALUE = M.DEPARTMENT_ID) OR (CT.TARGET_TYPE = '직급' AND CT.TARGET_VALUE = M.POSITION_ID) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ENROLLMENT E WHERE E.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND E.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} )

INSERT INTO ENROLLMENT ( ENROLLMENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, COURSE_ID, STATUS, START_DATE, COMPLETED_DATE ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(ENROLLMENT_ID), 0) FROM ENROLLMENT) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CT.COURSE_ID), M.MEMBER_ID, CT.COURSE_ID, 'Y', SYSDATE, NULL FROM MEMBER M JOIN COURSE_TARGET CT ON ( CT.TARGET_TYPE = '전체' OR (CT.TARGET_TYPE = '부서' AND CT.TARGET_VALUE = M.DEPARTMENT_ID) OR (CT.TARGET_TYPE = '직급' AND CT.TARGET_VALUE = M.POSITION_ID) ) JOIN COURSE C ON C.COURSE_ID = CT.COURSE_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND M.STATUS = 'Y' AND M.ROLE = 'N' AND C.STATUS = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ENROLLMENT E WHERE E.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND E.COURSE_ID = CT.COURSE_ID )
mapper.select: SELECT C.COURSE_ID AS courseId, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, C.DESCRIPTION AS description, C.FILE_ID AS fileId, M.NAME AS name, C.STATUS AS status, C.START_DATE AS startDate, C.END_DATE AS endDate, C.TOTAL_HOURS AS totalHours, C.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, C.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, CASE WHEN A.FILE_PATH IS NOT NULL AND A.CHANGED_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN A.FILE_PATH || A.CHANGED_NAME ELSE NULL END AS thumbnailUrl, A.ORIGINAL_NAME AS thumbnailOriginalName, (SELECT CT.TARGET_TYPE FROM COURSE_TARGET CT WHERE CT.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS targetType, (SELECT CT.TARGET_VALUE FROM COURSE_TARGET CT WHERE CT.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS targetValue FROM COURSE C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ATTACHMENT A ON C.FILE_ID = A.FILE_ID AND A.STATUS = 'Y' WHERE C.COURSE_ID = #{courseId}

SELECT PROGRESS_ID AS progressId, ENROLLMENT_ID AS enrollmentId, CHAPTER_ID AS chapterId, WATCHED_SECONDS AS watchedSeconds, LAST_POSITION_SECONDS AS lastPositionSeconds, CHAP_COMP_RATE AS chapCompRate, IS_COMPLETED AS isCompleted FROM CHAPTER_PROGRESS WHERE ENROLLMENT_ID = #{enrollmentId} AND CHAPTER_ID = #{chapterId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CHAPTER_PROGRESS CP USING ( SELECT #{enrollmentId} AS ENROLLMENT_ID, #{chapterId} AS CHAPTER_ID FROM DUAL ) SRC ON (CP.ENROLLMENT_ID = SRC.ENROLLMENT_ID AND CP.CHAPTER_ID = SRC.CHAPTER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CP.WATCHED_SECONDS = GREATEST(CP.WATCHED_SECONDS, #{watchedSeconds}), CP.LAST_POSITION_SECONDS = #{lastPositionSeconds}, CP.CHAP_COMP_RATE = GREATEST(CP.CHAP_COMP_RATE, #{chapCompRate}), CP.IS_COMPLETED = CASE WHEN CP.IS_COMPLETED = 'Y' OR #{isCompleted} = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PROGRESS_ID, ENROLLMENT_ID, CHAPTER_ID, WATCHED_SECONDS, LAST_POSITION_SECONDS, CHAP_COMP_RATE, IS_COMPLETED) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(PROGRESS_ID), 0) + 1 FROM CHAPTER_PROGRESS), #{enrollmentId}, #{chapterId}, #{watchedSeconds}, #{lastPositionSeconds}, #{chapCompRate}, #{isCompleted} )
